features: Auto motorized back focus / lens wizard
Hybrid IP + analog video output (SMB, CVBS PAL/NTSC)
CS-mount (C-mount with adapter ring), lens sold separately
2 alarm inputs, 1 relay output, RS-232/422/485 data port
ONVIF Profile S, G and Q
Cloud services: JPEG posting to FTP / Dropbox
dimensions_mm: 78 x 66 x 140 (W x H x L, without lens)
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NBN_71022_Data_sheet_enUS_14398127371.pdf). NBN-71022-B = MOTION+ motion detection; NBN-71022-BA = with Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA). Hardware identical. Max power consumption 10.8 W is the 24 VAC IVA figure (PoE IVA 8.4 W). Operating temperature with IVA is -20 to 50 C. Sensitivity at F1.2, 30 IRE. Datasheet dated May 2016.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
